latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Multisig Decision Framework skill.

- Guides users through understanding multisig wallets and deciding when they are appropriate.
- Helps design signer configurations (thresholds, distribution, recovery) for personal, family, or small organization scenarios.
- Outlines common pitfalls and provides recovery planning for lost signers.
- Does not recommend specific products, inspect contracts, or verify on-chain data.
- Explains decisions using clear, jargon-free language with practical examples.
